_sources.name: ND-GAIN Country Index (University of Notre Dame), 2026 release, data year 2024
WorldRiskIndex 2025 (WorldRiskReport, Bündnis Entwicklung Hilft / IFHV Ruhr-Univ. Bochum); 2026 data package, 2026 values identical to 2025
INFORM Risk Index Mid-2026 v0.7.3 (EC JRC DRMKC), released 1 Sep 2026
World Bank Climate Change Knowledge Portal, CMIP6 0.25deg ensemble median: hi35, hi39, hd40, tr26, txx, tas (1995-2014, 2040-2059 SSP2-4.5/SSP3-7.0, 2080-2099 SSP2-4.5)
IPCC AR6 WGI/WGII regional chapters & Atlas (hazard lists, heat-score adjustments)

_method: ndgain/ndgainVuln: ND-GAIN 2026 release, latest data year 2024 (index 0-100; vulnerability 0-1). wri: WorldRiskIndex 2025 score (0-100, higher = more risk; geometric mean of exposure x vulnerability). inform: INFORM Risk Mid-2026 (0-10). hazards: up to 5, ordered by importance; seeded from INFORM hazard sub-scores (earthquake, flood, tsunami, cyclone, drought) and WRI exposure domains (incl. sea-level rise), then completed by expert judgement for volcano, wildfire, extreme heat, landslide, cold/snow (IPCC AR6 regional chapters). heat: 100*exp(-S/55) capped at 98, where S = 0.30*hi35 + 0.45*hi39 + 0.40*hd40 + 0.05*tr26 (all 2040-2059 SSP2-4.5 days/yr: heat index >35/>39C, Tmax >40C, nights >26C) + 0.06*hi35(2080-2099 SSP2-4.5, for long-term trajectory) + 2.5*max(0, TXx-33C) + 1.5*max(0, Tmean-20C); minus up to 12 for very cold mean climates (Tmean<4C). CCKP values are country area-averages, so for large or topographically diverse countries (e.g. USA, CHN, AUS, BRA, JPN, ETH, KEN, NPL, Mediterranean states) the formula value was replaced by an expert population-weighted estimate when they differed by >=5 points. est=true when any index value was imputed from analogue countries (TWN, HKG, MAC, XKX, SSD, SMR, AND, MCO) or heat was expert-adjusted.
